scope: Validate the four stable-release criteria after development selection, with Jev used as a descriptive reference.

condition_test.role: independent condition transfer; first evaluated after candidate and calibration freeze

task_regression.role: exposed multi-task regression; preserve original bytes and existing predictions
task_regression.language_review: Flag a task-language decline greater than five percentage points with an entirely negative paired source-group 95% interval. Inspect any flagged slice before release.
task_regression.numeric_repair: Recover predecessor overall accuracy, at least 90% for disabled gates and missing fields.

runtime.dynamic_choice: Verify schema, cardinality and normalization; report semantic exact-match errors separately.

report: Separate independent condition results from exposed multi-task regression. Include both local baselines and fixed Jev 1.13.0 comparisons, paired uncertainty, remaining errors, input limits, calibration, lineage, licenses and actual export/API measurements.
